definitions.explanation: A removable fabric cover for a futon (Japanese-style bedding), used to keep the futon clean and to allow easy washing.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}カバーを{洗濯|せんたく}した。
{新|あたら}しい{布団|ふとん}カバーに{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I changed to a new futon cover.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}に{合|あ}わせて{布団|ふとん}カバーの{色|いろ}や{素材|そざい}を{変|か}えるのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like to change the color and material of my futon cover to match the season.

notes:
USAGE:
A common household item in Japan. {布団|ふとん}カバー can refer to covers for both the {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} (duvet/comforter) and {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん} (mattress pad), though it most often refers to the duvet cover.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布団|ふとん}カバーを{掛|か}ける (to put on a futon cover)
- {布団|ふとん}カバーを{外|はず}す (to remove a futon cover)
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}カバー (duvet cover)
- {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}カバー (mattress cover)
